statement: There is a provably discontinuous abstract section G_Q -> pi_1(P1 minus {0,1,infinity}) whose restriction to G_Q3 is geometrically conjugate to the continuous point section at a=1+sum_{r>=1}3^(r!), transcendental over Q. Its semilinear pro-cover action normalizes the original geometric deck group.
manuscript_passages: cote 149, pp.62v--63, scans126--127; D5 abstract semilinear action
doubtful_reading: Uses exactly abstract semilinear actions, without a hidden continuity assumption. Completed points are geometric closed pro-points as fixed in D.7.
notes: Root proposed the ultralimit and CRT construction; the Part F agent independently checked and wrote the full argument. Local finite-quotient conjugators are proved geometric by fixing the constant quotient of each F-torsor. Discontinuity follows from the z^2=t character and a surjective product of independent quadratic characters, not from the section conjecture. Twelve exact CRT points and the identity valuation matrix are certified in code/F_D5_ultralimit_output.json. The ultrafilter itself is not an effective algorithm. The requested R22 crossed cocycle is a_g=s(g)rho_0(g)^(-1), explicitly written with its ultralimit and crossed identity. Root independently accepted the final written proof.

statement: For finite L/Q_p and H equal to the kernel of the full cyclotomic character, a p-adic Kummer class of b in L* vanishing on H forces b to be a root of unity.
manuscript_passages: D5 local obstruction to a cyclotomic fixed completed pro-point
doubtful_reading: The full cyclotomic kernel is used, not an unannounced replacement by the p-cyclotomic kernel.
notes: Because H acts trivially on Z_p(1), the cocycle literally vanishes on H and descends continuously to the compact abelian cyclotomic image. A nontrivial p-cyclotomic scalar kills its cohomology class; the local intersection of all p^n powers is exactly the prime-to-p roots of unity. This proves the required compact-coefficient inflation step directly.

statement: The universal D5 assertion that every abstract semilinear action has exactly one G_Q-cyclotomic-kernel fixed completed geometric closed pro-point is false: D.12 gives an action with empty fixed set, already normalizing the original deck group.
manuscript_passages: cote149 pp.62v--63 scans126--127; universal first clause of D5
doubtful_reading: The generic scheme point is excluded by the geometric-closed-pro-point convention explicitly adopted in D.7. The existence clause is refuted; this example does not refute an at-most-one assertion.
notes: A fixed pro-point would lie over algebraic x. After finite local extension and local conjugacy, evaluation of a rational unit regular at x makes f(a)/f(x) a root of unity by D.13, contradicting explicit transcendence of a. The three cusp cases are included. The action is proven discontinuous, so this proves no counterexample to the continuous section conjecture D1--D4. D.11 separately proves existence of an action normalizing no finite-quotient deck group. Root independently accepted the final written proof and directed removal of superseded D.U5.
